function: MIMO channel estimation from pilot measurements, also with low-resolution ADCs and noisy training data, using a diffusion-model prior with posterior sampling (p. 2).
system: Point-to-point narrowband MIMO downlink, fully digital, ULAs with Nt=64 BS and Nr=16 user antennas, no RIS; 40 GHz carrier (p. 2, 3, 7).
method: Diffusion model (lightweight CNN denoiser) as channel prior, trained unsupervised on channel samples; posterior sampling at inference; SURE-DM variant trains on noisy channels (p. 4, 6).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa 3GPP 38.901 urban macro LOS channels at 40 GHz: 100,000 training samples, 100 test realizations at new UT locations; NLOS channels for mismatch test (p. 7, 9).
test_conditions: Trained on LOS channels only; tested at unseen UT locations over SNR, pilot density, ADC bits, and in NLOS without retraining (p. 4, 7, 9).
baselines: Classical: LMMSE, BLMMSE, LASSO, EM-GM-AMP. Learned: LDAMP, VAE, SGM, and the diffusion-based estimator of [26] (alpha=1 only) (p. 8-9).
metrics: NMSE, estimation latency, FLOPs, parameter count, and end-to-end BER of LDPC-coded 64-QAM downlink (p. 7, 11, 12).
complexity: DM: 5.5G FLOPs, 4.17 ms (16x64 antennas); 22.4G FLOPs, 10 ms (32x128); 5.50e4 parameters; SGM needs 5.89e6 parameters (Table I, p. 12).
openness: none (GitHub links on p. 8 are only baseline implementations)
q1_support: p. 7: "We adopt the QuaDRiGa toolbox [49] as the channel simulator to generate training, testing, and validation data"
q2_support: p. 9: "we deploy the DM trained using LOS channel samples in a non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenario"
q3_support: p. 10: "outperforms linear (BLMMSE), CS-based (EM-GM-AMP), and DL-based (VAE) estimators by more than 1 dB in NMSE"
q4_support: p. 12: "the latency, and the number of parameters in the model, as shown in Table I"
q5_support: p. 7: "We adopt the QuaDRiGa toolbox [49] as the channel simulator to generate training, testing, and validation data"; self-generated simulation data, and no link to own code or dataset (GitHub links on p. 8 are baseline code only)
notes: Version read: arXiv v3 preprint (9 Mar 2026) of the TWC paper, 14 pages. QuaDRiGa follows the 3GPP 38.901 urban macro LOS scenario (p. 7). q2 rests on the LOS-to-NLOS mismatch test of Fig. 7 (p. 9), without retraining. q3 learned baselines (LDAMP, VAE, SGM) are earlier published estimators, compared on NMSE in Figs. 4, 5, 8 to 10.
